prompt: Internationalize Angular 21 component with i18n attributes, ICU plural/select, interpolation, attribute i18n, $localize tagged templates.

assertions.name: i18n_attribute_with_meaning
assertions.description: Uses i18n attribute with meaning|description syntax (e.g., i18n='site header|App title')

assertions.name: icu_plural
assertions.description: ICU plural expression with =0, =1, few, other cases

assertions.name: icu_select
assertions.description: ICU select expression for gender with male, female, other cases

assertions.name: i18n_on_attributes
assertions.description: Uses i18n-placeholder, i18n-title, or similar attribute i18n markers

assertions.name: localize_tagged_template
assertions.description: Uses $localize`...` tagged template literal in TypeScript code
